ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2023 entering class (ADM2023) and fall 2023 enrollment (EF2023A); College Navigator

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class). UNLV's 2025-26 and 2024-25 Common Data Set PDFs on it.unlv.edu have no readable text layer for the filled-in values (only the blank form text extracts), so the IPEDS baseline is used; GPA, residency splits and factors are not added. Undergrad enrollment (25,794) and nonresident undergrads (446) are IPEDS fall 2023 (EF2023A); student-faculty ratio 19 to 1 is College Navigator (fall 2024). College Navigator also shows fall 2024: 12,730 applicants, 96% admitted.
